# Duality Salon

> Duality Salon is a hair salon at 1606 Hopkins Road in Williamsville, NY 14221, serving Williamsville, Amherst and the greater Buffalo area. Founded in 2020 by mother-daughter team Sue and Leah, it offers hair color, highlights, balayage, gray coverage, vivid color, haircuts and curly haircuts. Every appointment starts with a consultation, and the salon does not overbook.

## Key facts

- Name: Duality Salon
- Address: 1606 Hopkins Road, Williamsville, NY 14221
- Phone: (716) 998-8528
- Email: info@dualitysalonbuffalo.com
- Hours: Tuesday by appointment only; Wednesday and Thursday 10 AM to 8 PM; Friday 9 AM to 5 PM; Saturday 9 AM to 3 PM; closed Sunday and Monday
- Online booking: https://login.meevo.com/DualitySalonBuffalo/ob?locationId=105068
- Established: 2020
- Team: Sue Dicky (Artistic Director), Leah Blachaniec (Owner and Stylist), Amanda Pohlman, Darcy Ragione and Marianna Campione (Stylists)
- Prices are starting points; the stylist confirms the final price at the consultation based on hair length, thickness and the look the client wants.

## Services

- [Hair color](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/hair-color-williamsville-ny/): all-over color from $100, highlights from $95, balayage from $140, root touch-ups from $70, with a free consultation
- [Gray coverage and root touch-up](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/gray-coverage-williamsville-ny/): root retouch from $70, all-over coverage from $100
- [Balayage](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/balayage-buffalo-ny/): hand-painted balayage from $140
- [Highlights and lowlights](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/highlights-williamsville-ny/): partial highlights from $95, full highlights from $130, toner from $40
- [Vivid and fashion color](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/vivid-hair-color-williamsville-ny/): bright and creative color, priced at a free consultation
- [Haircuts](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/haircuts-williamsville-ny/): haircut with blow-dry from $60, haircut without blow-dry from $40, kids' haircuts (under 12) from $35, clipper cuts and fades
- [Curly haircuts](https://dualitysalonbuffalo.com/curly-haircuts-williamsville-ny/): curly cut and style from $75, curly style from $50
